tasks.summary: Added callable JSON-schema validation support for const, oneOf, array items, additionalProperties false, unsupported keyword rejection, and focused validator coverage.
Added callable checkpoint schemas and isolated .ripplegraph/calls storage helpers with id validation, duplicate rejection, artifacts, transition logs, and call listing.
Added callable package resolution plus start, state, and list APIs with input validation, gate rejection, supported-schema preflight checks, and state responses that preserve original input.
Implemented callable step execution with validation errors, edge selection, artifact persistence, transition logging, completed checkpoints, final output responses, and non-active call rejection.
Wired dispatcher call_graph actions to start callable calls with optional callId and added JSON CLI call, call-state, call-step, and call-list commands with focused integration coverage.
Documented callable lifecycle, state isolation, validation subset, dispatcher call_graph behavior, remaining effects/workflow-call gaps, and rebuilt tracked dist output.
